weakness: No account procedure, approvals, reviews, or monitoring; seasonal assistant's accounts disabled 12 weeks late and the portal staff account found still active
source: P07 (AC-02 objectives); P01 R-007; P03 G-010
remediation_plan: Onboarding and termination checklist covering suite, tax software, portal, payroll and accounting platforms, and AI assistant; end dates on seasonal accounts; monthly reconciliation
milestones: 2026-08-04 portal account removed; 2026-09-30 checklist in use; 2026-10-31 first monthly reconciliation
resources_required: Office Manager time (1 hour a month)

weakness: Push MFA without number matching; MFP "scanner" mailbox uses an app password over legacy authentication that bypasses MFA
remediation_plan: Turn on number matching; move scan-to-email to a send-only connector or scan-to-portal; block legacy authentication tenant-wide
milestones: 2026-08-05 MFP admin password changed; 2026-09-15 number matching on; 2026-09-30 legacy authentication blocked

weakness: Backup console and firewall management login accept a password only; one shared MSP administrator account
remediation_plan: MSP enables MFA on both and replaces the shared account with named technician accounts; sends screenshots

weakness: Global administrator rights on everyday email accounts; all staff can open all client folders including payroll
remediation_plan: Separate administrator accounts for the Owner CPA and Office Manager; two sealed break-glass accounts; payroll folders limited to the Bookkeeper and Owner CPA; seasonal access to intake folders only
milestones: 2026-09-30 admin accounts separated; 2026-10-31 folder permissions changed

weakness: No audit log review or alerting
remediation_plan: Suite alert policies (inbox rules, external forwarding, risky sign-ins, mass downloads) to the Office Manager and MSP; one year of log retention; monthly review checklist including bank account changes on returns
milestones: 2026-10-15 plan upgrade and alerts on; 2026-10-31 first monthly review
resources_required: About $720 a year; Office Manager time (30 minutes a month)

weakness: Training was a single 2024 video; seasonal staff untrained; no phishing exercises
remediation_plan: Annual training before each season covering BEC, the call-back rule, IRC 7216, and AI use; quarterly phishing simulations; training before access for seasonal staff
milestones: 2026-10-31 provider selected; 2026-12-15 first training; 2027-01-15 first simulation

weakness: Staff not told how and when to report; IRS, FTC, and state reporting duties unknown
source: P07 interviews; P01 R-020; P03 G-041, G-052
remediation_plan: Reporting rule (POL-03 4.2) on a card at every desk; P08 notification matrix; tabletop covering the Stakeholder Liaison call and the FTC form

weakness: Backups not confirmed immutable; shared MSP account without MFA can delete them; tenant and firewall settings not backed up
remediation_plan: Confirm immutable retention for one year; named MSP accounts with MFA (with POAM-003); export suite settings and firewall configuration monthly

weakness: No contingency plan or full restore test ever
remediation_plan: Full restore of one mailbox and one client folder tree; quarterly restore tests recorded; short contingency plan from the BIA with a deadline-week checklist
milestones: 2026-09-30 first full restore test; 2026-11-30 contingency plan; 2026-12-31 second test

weakness: No time limit for disabling access; MFA and phone mail profiles not revoked; no exit reminder of IRC 7216 duties
remediation_plan: Last-day checklist (same as POAM-001) including MFA removal, phone mail profile removal, and a signed reminder of 7216 duties

weakness: Risk assessment never updated; no trigger for material changes such as new AI tools
remediation_plan: Annual update each July and after material changes under POL-02 A.3, with the consumer recount

weakness: No security requirements or monitoring for providers; MSP evidence not received; AI assistant adopted without review
remediation_plan: Vendor inventory with risk tiers; MSP contract amendment with security terms and 72-hour breach notice; annual MSP questionnaire with evidence; portal and payroll vendor evidence; AI vendor deletion request and terms review (P10)
milestones: 2026-09-30 AI vendor deletion request; 2026-10-31 vendor inventory; 2026-12-31 MSP amendment and reviews
resources_required: Owner CPA and Office Manager time

remediation_plan: Portal-only delivery of returns; suite rule blocking outbound attachments with SSNs unless encrypted; client notice of the change
milestones: 2026-10-31 rule on; 2026-12-31 portal-only delivery announced to clients
resources_required: MSP labor (about 1 hour); Client Services Coordinator time

weakness: 4 desktops unencrypted; MFP keeps scanned images
remediation_plan: MSP enables full-disk encryption on the 4 desktops; image overwrite on the MFP; drive wipe certificate at lease end
milestones: 2026-10-31 desktops encrypted; 2026-10-31 image overwrite on; 2027-03-31 lease return

weakness: Confidentiality agreement lacks IRC 7216 and 6713; seasonal staff start before signing; MSP technicians never received the written notice
remediation_plan: Update the agreement; signature before access; written 6713 and 7216 notice signed by each MSP and MFP lessor technician
